body: Preflight for the saved bounded interoperability scope: src/core/repo/layout.ts already provides resolveLayout(root,{mode}) and DM_DIR; reuse that convention. Public Workspace exposes repoRoot, execute and ctx(), while Ctx exposes projectRoot but deliberately no RepoLayout. The concrete RepositoryWorkspace has a live layout field; avoid broadening Ctx or trusting renderer paths just to obtain the owned record. Prefer a minimal main-owned binding from the current trusted workspace/root and live storage status (DB mode has no in-repository record). Source inspection confirms existing main Kanban helpers use pure injected factories, e.g. startKanbanCard.ts. LSP reports no configured server here. DM-807 is active; do not start or edit this prerequisite until server-ready after accepted row-7 integration.
